prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1284; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is regarding the collision you were involved in on a roadway in Pearland, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your current address for the record.

A: I'm at a residence in Pearland, Texas.

Q: Can you describe what you were doing right before the collision?

A: I was driving home from work. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me, so I was stopped at a light when I got hit from behind.

Q: How fast do you believe the other vehicle was going at impact?

A: It's hard to say exactly, but it didn't look like they were slowing down at all. I heard the brakes squeal just before the hit.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you have any immediate complaints of injury at the scene?

A: My neck was sore, but the real problem was my right knee. It hit the dashboard when I was thrown forward, and it swelled up pretty quickly.

Q: Did you seek medical treatment after the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same evening. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor.

Q: Have you been able to return to work since the collision?

A: Not fully. I'm on light duty right now, and I can't stand for long periods without pain.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I'm willing to provide my medical records and whatever else you need to process this claim.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
